notes: Sales are confirmed, completed transactions only: eBay sold listings read from the listing page itself, plus eBay and TCGplayer completed sales republished by PriceCharting for the six cards it catalogues. Active listings, ended-unsold listings and listings whose final price is hidden are never counted as sales.

Only the Plated Legends (metal) Prize Wall printing counts. The foil Release-Event promos that share a card number (for example Ahri #255 'Release Event Prize Pack') are filtered out by listing title.

PSA populations come from the PSA data widget on eBay listing pages (PSA 10 count and total PSA-graded count for that card) as of the asOf date; cards with no PSA 10 listing on eBay have no population reading yet.
Raw-market prices are TCGplayer market prices for the ungraded metal card on the asOf date, used only as the basis for the gem-premium component.
